The required artifact tree contains exactly artifact.json and signature and therefore is distinct when artifact.json OID is distinct.
The required commit names that distinct tree and is therefore distinct.
All three objects must be included by the complete accepted exchange closure; aliases/raw opaque commit bodies cannot count as additional verified signed records.
